result:
Both test classes compile and pass under `--release 8`, JUnit 5 (jupiter), fully self-contained with no imports from other test classes:

- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/DurationUtilsAgentTest.java` — covers `accept`, `get`/`getMillis`/`getSeconds` defaulting, `getNanosOfMilli`/deprecated alias, `isPositive`, `of(Consumer/Runnable)` success and exception propagation, `since`, `toChronoUnit` via `toDuration` for every `TimeUnit`, `toMillisInt` clamping (both the `fit()` range-clamp path and the `ArithmeticException` overflow path for `Long.MAX_VALUE`/`MIN_VALUE` seconds) plus its null-check, and `zeroIfNull`.
- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/StopWatchAgentTest.java` — covers construction/state transitions (`start`/`stop`/`suspend`/`resume`/`reset`), illegal-state errors for each disallowed transition, splits (`split`, `split(label)`, `unsplit`, multiple accumulating splits, unmodifiable split list), timing getters (`getTime`, `getTime(TimeUnit)`, `getDuration`, `getNanoTime`, start/stop instants and their deprecated millis equivalents), `toString`/`toSplitString`/`formatSplitTime`, and the functional helpers `run`, `get`, `runT`, `getT` including checked-exception propagation.

`./_tools/test.sh` runs all 64 test methods with 0 failures.
